method: Read-only web search/open of indexed primary reference pages, anchor resolution, and direct import of local shared/catalog.mjs. Linked presence is observed; implementation equivalence and priority are analyst inferences. Live functionality was not tested.
countCaveat: Reference marketing totals conflict (20+, 100+, 500+); these are not inventory counts. Sitemap requests were inaccessible. This records the explicitly observed missing/partial capabilities, not a claim of a complete reference-site crawl.
